change.description: Add independent Playbook catalog and source visibility, deterministic public and private supplement packages, and an authenticated administrator read model while preserving the public package and notification identity.
change.release_unit_description: static frontend and full-feature Docker image

planned.reasoning: The change adds an administrator-only Playbook overlay, additive release assets, an independent visibility projection, and a source-bound persisted supplement staging file. Existing public package names, public routes, and public content remain compatible.

evidence.command: Playbook SPEC defines independent visibility, public package compatibility, and the administrator supplement contract

current.reasoning: The implementation keeps the public edition unchanged at its boundary while adding a source-bound protected supplement receiver, authenticated administrator browsing, and persisted overlay staging; invalid supplement data is isolated from public adoption, rollback retries are idempotent only for the exact published identity, and production frozen inputs and backend-dist exclude the supplement from public product artifacts.

evidence.command: Release reader validates public identity; exact rollback retries are idempotent and conflicting identities fail closed
Release policy recognizes a verified release carried by a non-first-parent branch merge without accepting an unregistered VERSION change
Authenticated administrator Playbook browse and search route
Protected receiver validates source-bound supplement payloads and persists only accepted overlay metadata

scope_drift.description: The candidate remains limited to the upstream Playbook data contract, dual release assets, Blog receiver, administrator read model, and their tests and documentation.

verified.reasoning: Public and supplement package validation, source identity checks, administrator authorization, strict duplicate-key request parsing, HTTPS-only supplement sync endpoints, public artifact exclusion, raw-body preservation, deterministic assets, persisted overlay recovery, exact rollback retry handling, frozen seed byte validation, and the relevant Blog test and check suites pass.

evidence.command: Workflow boundary tests reject non-HTTPS sync endpoints and assert that supplements stay out of public frozen and backend artifacts
Supplement identity, exact rollback retry, and failure isolation tests keep public release paths distinct
Public catalog validation compatibly reads the legacy visibility and missing-preamble shape without changing Markdown bytes
Retained public editions verify and preserve legacy package file identities while rebuilding policy resources
Release source tests cover VERSION provenance across registered merge commits, branch merges, and preparation markers
Public and supplement contract tests preserve shared Markdown bytes, validate Rust fixture bytes, rollback identity, and supplement seed bytes
Initial bootstrap resolves the exact pointer release and fails closed on invalid or unavailable supplement assets
HTTP compatibility tests cover anonymous, authenticated user, and administrator Playbook access

persistent_state.state_description: The receiver adds an optional source-bound supplement-state.json file alongside the existing Playbook cache. It is an additive, replaceable overlay projection: prior versions ignore the unknown file, and the current version can discard or rebuild it from the verified supplement asset without a database migration.

evidence.command: Playbook cache persists an optional source-bound supplement and keeps malformed or mismatched data out of the admin read model
Supplement persistence and conflicting overlay adoption retain a public-only fallback
